canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall f : Nat -> alpha -> ENNReal, (forall n, Measurable (f n)) -> Monotone f -> lintegral (fun a => iSup fun n => f n a) mu = iSup fun n => lintegral (f n) mu
canonical_formal_target.candidate_relationship: lintegral_iSup is the closest candidate to Axler 3.11 after identifying a pointwise increasing sequence's limit with its supremum; the AE, Tendsto, directed-family, and real-valued forms make proposition-changing choices and require checked source-approved transports.

domain_and_universes: Open: the modern candidate is an arbitrary measure space with nonnegative extended-real functions, while the catalog's real-analysis label could also be read as Lebesgue measure on a real domain or an ordinary-real corollary. Universe, measurable-space, measure, value type, and implicit-parameter choices require source approval.
conclusion: Open: expected family interchanges the monotone pointwise limit and the Lebesgue integral, but the catalog does not choose an equality of extended-real suprema, explicit Tendsto of lintegrals, or convergence of finite real integrals.
